# Family Handyman

> > Comprehensive DIY home improvement guides, expert advice, and product reviews for homeowners tackling repairs, renovations, and maintenance projects.

Family Handyman provides practical how-to guides, professional contractor advice, and tested product recommendations covering everything from electrical work and HVAC systems to painting, landscaping, and home organization. Content features expert contributors including Nick Gerhardt, Elizabeth Flaherty, Doug Baltzer, Steve Maxwell, and Chris Deziel.

## Key Topics

- DIY home improvement
- Home maintenance and repair
- Electrical systems and subpanels
- HVAC upgrades and energy efficiency
- Painting and exterior finishes
- Insulation and weatherproofing
- Contractor licensing and regulations
- Product reviews and recommendations
- Landscaping and yard maintenance
- Home organization and decluttering
- Plumbing and water systems
- Building codes and permits
- Storage solutions
- Outdoor projects and hardscaping

## Home Systems and Utilities

- [Can You Daisy-Chain Subpanels?](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/subpanel-daisy-chain): Chief Electrical Inspector explains subpanel daisy-chaining regulations
- [Old Homes Can Save Big Money with an HVAC Update](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/old-homes-can-save-big-money-with-an-hvac-update): Energy-efficient HVAC upgrades for older homes using ductless mini-splits
- [What To Know About Grey Water](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/grey-water): Guide to grey water systems for water conservation and landscape irrigation
- [Save Time With a DIY Self-Draining Dehumidifier](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/save-time-with-a-diy-self-draining-dehumidifier): DIY guide for converting dehumidifier to self-draining with condensate pump
- [Determining Utility Accessibility Before You Build](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/utility-easement-accessibility-before-building-home): Guide to researching utility easements and access before buying land

## Exterior Projects and Maintenance

- [How To Get Great Results Painting Cedar Siding](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/cedar-siding): Pro tips for painting cedar siding with surface prep recommendations
- [Two Simple Steps to Protect Your Exterior Stone Work](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/simple-steps-to-protect-your-exterior-stonework): Applying silane/siloxane sealer to protect exterior stone from freeze damage
- [Foam Insulation Alternatives for DIY Projects](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/foam-insulation-alternatives): Guide to alternative insulation options during foam shortage periods
- [Walking Path Upgrade](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/walking-path-upgrade): Installing concrete walkway using Quikrete WalkMaker stepping-stone system

## Contractor and Building Guidance

- [The Crucial Difference Between Licensed and Unlicensed Contractors](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/the-crucial-difference-between-licensed-and-unlicensed-contractors): Explains legal liabilities and risks of hiring unlicensed contractors
- [Bathroom Chandeliers: What To Know Before You Buy](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/bathroom-chandeliers): Bathroom chandelier placement guide covering National Electric Code requirements

## Tools and Techniques

- [How to Cut Threaded Rod: Best Way for Perfect Length Every Time](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/cutting-threaded-rod): Technique for cutting threaded rod without damaging threads using hacksaw
- [High-Flying Tree Limb Cutter](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/high-flying-tree-limb-cutter): DIY rope-saw technique for removing high tree branches out of reach

## Product Reviews and Recommendations

- [Review: We Tried Space-Saver Bags for Clothes, Towels and More](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/space-saver-bags): Product review of Spacesaver Vacuum Storage Bags for clothing organization
- [Google Nest Thermostats: Learning vs. Thermostat E](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/google-nest-learning-thermostat-e): Comparison of Nest Learning Thermostat and Thermostat E smart models

## Home Organization and Interior Design

- [Does This Daily 15-Minute Decluttering Hack Really Work?](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/does-this-daily-15-minute-decluttering-hack-really-work): Tests FlyLady's 15-minute daily decluttering method for home organization
- [Paint Colors That Make Your Home Look Dirty](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/paint-colors-that-make-your-home-look-dirty): Five paint color pitfalls and undertone issues that create dingy appearance

## Yard and Landscape

- [Five Easy Ways to Reduce Yard Work](https://www.familyhandyman.com/article/five-easy-ways-to-reduce-yard-work): Time-saving landscaping tips for reducing lawn maintenance demands
